selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the man first think when he heard the verse?
questions.answer: He thought it did not sound special or amazing.

questions.question: What was he told to imagine doing?
questions.answer: He was told to picture himself going back to the time when the Qur’an was first being recited.

questions.question: Before hearing the verse in that picture, how did the world seem?
questions.answer: It seemed dark, confused, and without clear purpose.

questions.question: What changed when the verse was heard?
questions.answer: It made the world seem bright and meaningful.

questions.question: What did the verse help uncover, like lifting something away?
questions.answer: It removed a covering from how the universe was understood.

questions.question: After that, what did the universe seem like?
questions.answer: It seemed like one huge place of worship.

questions.question: Which parts of creation are named as praising Allah?
questions.answer: The heavens and the earth.

questions.question: How was creation acting after the verse was heard?
questions.answer: It was remembering Allah and doing its job with joy.

questions.question: What did the traveler learn from seeing this?
questions.answer: He learned that the Qur’an’s words have great beauty and power.

questions.question: What is one reason given for why the Qur’an spread so far and stayed honored so long?
questions.answer: Its beautiful and powerful message reached many people and kept its greatness for many centuries.

questions.question: Which verse is being talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The verse saying that everything in the heavens and earth praises Allah.

questions.question: Why did someone need help understanding that verse?
questions.answer: He could not see its special beauty at first.

questions.question: What did he need to imagine in order to understand better?
questions.answer: He needed to imagine the world before the Qur’an was revealed.

questions.question: In that imagined time, how were things in the world described?
questions.answer: They seemed shaky, passing away, and full of darkness.

questions.question: Did the world seem alive with purpose before the verse in his picture?
questions.answer: No, it seemed empty of purpose.

questions.question: What did the verse do for the earth and the universe?
questions.answer: It made them seem lit up and easier to understand.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give for the whole universe after the verse?
questions.answer: It gives the picture of a giant mosque.

questions.question: What were all created things doing in that picture?
questions.answer: They were glorifying Allah and remembering Him.

questions.question: What feeling did creation show while doing its work?
questions.answer: Happiness and peace.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand about the Qur’an after this?
questions.answer: He understood that its words are deeply powerful and helped it reach many people for a very long time.

questions.question: At the start of the passage, what problem did the listener have?
questions.answer: He did not understand why the verse was so amazing.

questions.question: What was the advice given to him?
questions.answer: He was told to listen with the mind of someone living at the time of revelation.

questions.question: Why would going back in imagination help him?
questions.answer: It would help him feel how big the change was when the verse was first heard.

questions.question: How did the universe look before that change?
questions.answer: It looked lost, dark, and without awareness.
